So the 7-toggle H1 solution is safe under H1, H2, and any "segments must be red" variant. The only risk is if non-segments must be red (i.e., the goal is "make the whole diamond red" + segments… no).
Actually, wait, one more possibility: the goal is "make all cells red" (the diamond is complete, and the eyes are just decoration/aesthetic)?
